heldout.name: WordWorld new-command evaluation 2026-10-15
heldout.method: 50 new hand-authored commands and gold actions frozen before executing the parser. Author had access to implementation and development examples; not independently human-labeled or randomly sampled.
heldout.scope: 44 core commands plus 6 explicitly marked capability probes. Each command is parsed independently; pronoun probes contain their antecedents within the same command. Landmarks are assumed to exist; scene placement is not scored.
heldout.evaluation_kind: retest after parser development; not unseen-command accuracy

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.

fresh_v12.name: WordWorld twelfth fresh 50-command evaluation — 2026-10-18
fresh_v12.method: 50 newly hand-authored commands and expected actions frozen before first prediction. The place-filter grammar for edits and removals was already implemented, so these commands test it on unseen sentences, not on the sentences used to build it. The author wrote the grammar and saw prior errors; not independent.
fresh_v12.scope: 40 preassigned core cases (place filters on recolor/resize/remove/move, filter vs destination, coordination, creation wording that must not become a filter, negation and refusals, thirds/tenths/percentages, one context reference) and 10 broader probes (filter wordings, alternate "each" wordings, group multiplication, sixths, partial references).
fresh_v12.evaluation_kind: retest after parser development; not unseen-command accuracy

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.
